user.title: HEMS: choose your entities
user.description: HEMS only talks to Home Assistant entities. Pick one sensor per role. This version plans in dry-run and never switches a device.

data.battery_power_positive_is_discharging: Battery power is positive while discharging
data.grid_entity: Grid power at the meter (W, positive = import)
data.inverter_output_entity: Inverter AC output (W, optional; improves the house-load estimate)
data.ev_power_entity: EV charger power (W, optional; excluded from the base load)
data.price_curve_entity: Import price sensor with a price_curve attribute (optional; fallback and cross-check)

error.entity_not_found: One of the chosen entities does not exist.

init.title: HEMS settings
init.description: Battery, forecast and price components. The price components mirror the energy-prices add-on.

data.min_profit_margin: Minimum profit margin (EUR per discharged kWh, net of losses)
data.hold_cost_kwh_h: Waiting cost (EUR per stored kWh per hour; 0 = off, higher charges later before a sale)
data.pv_gain_w_per_wm2: PV gain (W per W/m2, 0 = calibrate automatically)
data.pv_max_ac_w: Peak PV output (W): the PV forecast is clipped here; use what the panels peak at, or the inverter AC limit if that is lower
data.export_energy_tax: Export energy tax refund (EUR/kWh, netting only)
data.bonus_only_daylight: Percentage bonus only between sunrise and sunset
data.bonus_only_positive_price: Percentage bonus only for a positive market price
data.nordpool_enabled: Fetch day-ahead prices from Nord Pool
data.trace_full_plan: Log the full plan every cycle (plans.jsonl, about 1 MB per day)
data.water_heater_enabled: Water heater module on (plans the daily heating run for the load forecast; HEMS does not control the heating)
data.water_heater_energy_kwh: Water heater: energy of a normal heating run (kWh)
data.water_heater_hours: Water heater: length of a normal heating run (hours)
data.water_heater_legionella_energy_kwh: Water heater: energy of the legionella run (kWh)
data.water_heater_legionella_hours: Water heater: length of the legionella run (hours)
data.water_heater_night_energy_kwh: Water heater: energy of the night run (kWh, 0 = no night run)

state.no_price_for_now: No price for the current quarter
